description: This file is a React component for displaying and editing detailed information about a machine learning model, including its settings, metadata, and associated actions such as testing connection, reusing credentials, and deleting the model.

methods.name: handleReuseCredential
methods.description: Handles storing existing credentials by calling API and displaying notifications.

methods.name: handleModelUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating the model's configuration by submitting form data, calling API, and updating local state.

methods.name: handleTestConnection
methods.description: Tests the connection to the model provider using current credentials and notifies success or failure.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes the model via API call, triggers parent update, and manages modal state.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies specified text to clipboard and provides visual feedback.

methods.name: handleAutoRouterUpdate
methods.description: Updates local model data after auto-router configuration is edited.
